AssumeRole.title: AssumeRole
AssumeRole.summary: Obtains a Security Token Service (STS) token to assume a Resource Access Management (RAM) role.

AssumeRoleWithOIDC.title: AssumeRoleWithOIDC
AssumeRoleWithOIDC.summary: For role-based single sign-on (SSO) that uses OpenID Connect (OIDC), call the AssumeRoleWithOIDC operation to obtain a temporary identity credential (a Security Token Service token) to assume a RAM role.

AssumeRoleWithSAML.title: AssumeRoleWithSAML
AssumeRoleWithSAML.summary: For role-based single sign-on (SSO) that uses Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), call the AssumeRoleWithSAML operation to obtain a temporary identity credential (a Security Token Service (STS) token) for a RAM role.

GetCallerIdentity.title: GetCallerIdentity
GetCallerIdentity.summary: A call to the GetCallerIdentity operation returns information about the identity of the current caller.
